summary: All 8 acceptance-matrix criteria exercised: 3 backend pytest assertions (public API edge bridge) + 6 named browser checks (public discovery, paid registration, admin verification, digital pass, scanner attendance with duplicate rejection, admin settings secret handling) + 1 responsive layout check. Everything passed against the live preview URL https://sage-mega-fest.preview.emergentagent.com.

checks.criterion: Public API edge bridge and negative case work
checks.name: test_tscheck_public_api_edge_bridge.py::test_health_ok

checks.criterion: Public API edge bridge and negative case work
checks.name: test_tscheck_public_api_edge_bridge.py::test_events_lists_programme_and_events
checks.evidence: GET /api/events -> 200 meta.programme='Euphoria 2026', data has 9 events incl. Dance Competition

checks.criterion: Public API edge bridge and negative case work
checks.name: test_tscheck_public_api_edge_bridge.py::test_event_not_found_returns_404

checks.criterion: Public festival discovery works on the deployed preview
checks.name: public-discovery-flow
checks.evidence: Home hero visible, Explore Events -> /events with 9 event cards, Dance Competition card opens detail page

checks.criterion: Paid event registration creates an honest pending payment record
checks.name: registration-creates-pending-payment
checks.evidence: Submitted unique participant -> EUPHORIA-2026-###### id, PENDING PAYMENT shown, no view-pass-button present pre-verification

checks.criterion: Admin authentication and manual finance verification work
checks.name: admin-verifies-payment
checks.evidence: Admin login -> /admin/registrations, located fresh row PENDING PAYMENT, clicked Mark Paid, toast 'Payment marked successful manually. Audit recorded.', row now CONFIRMED

checks.criterion: Confirmed registrations produce a secure event pass
checks.name: confirmed-registration-shows-digital-pass
checks.evidence: After admin verification, participant session reload showed View digital pass button; pass page shows participant, Dance Competition, reg id, Main auditorium, ACTIVE, QR image, and an opaque hash-like token containing no name/email

checks.criterion: Authorized scanner records attendance and rejects same-day duplicates
checks.name: scanner-records-attendance-and-blocks-duplicate
checks.evidence: Scanner login, Dance Competition/Day1/Gate1 selected, first scan of confirmed token -> 'Entry allowed', identical re-scan -> 'Already recorded'

checks.name: admin-settings-secures-integration-secrets
checks.evidence: /admin/settings shows EASEBUZZ NOT CONFIGURED / SMTP NOT CONFIGURED badges; merchant key/salt and SMTP password inputs are type=password and empty (never pre-filled)

checks.name: responsive-layout-no-overflow
checks.evidence: No horizontal overflow (scrollWidth<=clientWidth+2px) across home, events listing, event detail, registration form, admin overview/registrations/settings, and scanner at 1280x800

notes: 8 acceptance-matrix criteria covered by 10 artifacts (3 backend + 7 browser) as listed above; no criterion exceeded coverage requirements.

The digital pass button is session-scoped: it only appears in the browser session that created the registration after admin verification (confirmed via same-session reload), which matches the security-first design implied by the spec deviations.
Live payment gateway (Easebuzz) and SMTP delivery are intentionally unavailable per spec_deviations; not treated as bugs.
